messages:
maria: Quick sync follow-up on continuous-batching. We're trending toward subqueue-fences + opportunistic prefetch, but need a concise eviction contract, per-tenant pacing, and telemetry before we lock.
sam: Concern: fencing many tiny subqueues may cause metadata fragmentation and allocator GC spikes. Need mitigation.
lee: Add to that: per-subqueue structs cause memory churn at high cardinality. Consider pooling representations.
anika: Eviction contract proposal: soft-evict = cancel prefetches, deprioritize queue, allow inflight to drain; hard-evict = cancel inflight only when SLOs breached or emergency reclaim. Reclaim priority: prefetches -> queued tokens -> inflight small batches -> inflight large batches.
sam: Note: killing inflight small batches can trigger client retries. Doc must include idempotency/retry guidance.
lee: Accounting: introduce prefetch_quota (soft) charged to tenant and inflight_quota (strict) enforced globally per shard. Defaults can be suggested in docs.
anika: Telemetry wishlist: per-subqueue metrics (queued_tokens, prefetch_tokens, inflight_tokens, last_eviction_reason), eviction events (tenant_id, model_variant, queue_snapshot), eviction_rebuild_cost timer, post-eviction latency histogram. Retention: event traces 7d, rollups 90d.
maria: Handoff protocol (for local fences): origin marks subqueue "handing-off" and stops prefetches; origin drains within bounded window and emits checkpoint blob; target claims checkpoint and resumes prefetch. If drain stalls, escalate to forced checkpoint (truncated KV) and callers tolerate warmup. Example checkpoint shape (as logged): {tenant:T, model:m, kv_keys:[...], seq_hint:12345, queued_tokens:1024}.
sam: Broker vs local fences: prefer local fences with soft cross-shard reconciliation; central broker remains an ops fallback.
lee: Add per-tenant pacing knob (token-bucket) to throttle prefetch cadence. That plus prefetch_quota should curb noisy-prefetch cases.
ops-bot: CI: branch continuous-batching/subqueue-fence pushed; tests passed on main-ci.
maria: Action items: sam draft eviction + retry semantics; lee build local-fence POC; anika add telemetry tickets and dashboards; maria update RFC with checkpoint examples. If anyone objects to local fences, raise an issue on the RFC.
sam: I'll include sample quota numbers in my draft (e.g., inflight_quota=16 tokens, prefetch_quota=64 tokens) to give implementers a baseline.
lee: I'll add a config snippet to the POC repo.
anika: Filing telemetry tickets now. :rocket:
maria: Closing thread for now; will reopen if RFC changes land with breaking updates.
